findings.body: New evidence beyond the prior fix: production success responses always include `periodControl` (`backend/src/chat/chat.service.ts:583`), and custom controls use raw ISO labels (`chat.service.ts:1053-1059`). Returning that label here before formatting `appliedTimeWindow` means a `posting_date` range still renders as `2026-07-10 – 2026-07-20`; a full July range matching an option can collapse to `2026-07-01`. This affects both the readout and empty-state message. The new tests miss the production path because `postingDateWindowSuccess` deletes `periodControl` at `ask-panel.test.tsx:1089`. Format non-month windows from `appliedTimeWindow` before falling back to the control label, and cover the response with its control retained.
findings.title: Preserve exact non-month dates when a period control is present
